006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008/**
009 * FORG0001: Thrown when a cast operation fails because the supplied value
010 * cannot be converted to the target datatype.
011 */
012public class InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
013    extends InvalidArgumentFunctionException {
014
015  /**
016   * the serial version UUID.
017   */
018  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
019
020  /**
021   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code message} and no cause.
022   *
023   * @param message
024   *          the exception message
025   */
026  public InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(String message) {
027    super(INVALID_VALUE_FOR_CAST, message);
028  }
029
030  /**
031   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code message} and
032   * {@code cause}.
033   *
034   * @param message
035   *          the exception message
036   * @param cause
037   *          the original exception cause
038   */
039  public InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(String message, Throwable cause) {
040    super(INVALID_VALUE_FOR_CAST, message, cause);
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Constructs a new exception with no message and the provided {@code cause}.
045   *
046   * @param cause
047   *          the original exception cause
048   */
049  public InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(Throwable cause) {
050    super(INVALID_VALUE_FOR_CAST, cause);
051  }
052
053}
